body:
Source: GitHub issues #830 (bug, P1-high, false-green) and #832 (bug, P1-high, false-green), plugin plugins/adlc-herdr. Re-verified on main @ de8a130a. (a) lib/adlc-state.mjs: `readLatestPhase` (:244-245), `readLedgerTail` (:313-316) and `readLedgerByTicket` (:~341) each open ONLY `join(repoRoot, '.adlc', 'manifest.jsonl')`; grep for `manifest.d` in bin/ and lib/ returns nothing. Since the forest cutover a segmented repo freezes that root file and appends every new entry to `.adlc/manifest.d/<branch>-<ULID>.jsonl` (this repo has ~50 segments). Repro on this repo: `readLedgerByTicket(repoRoot, 3)` returns records from the cutover date and `readLatestPhase(repoRoot, <segment-only ticket>)` returns null — the board shows a frozen ledger and the pane `phase` token silently disappears. test/watcher.test.mjs:65 and test/board.test.mjs:52 fixtures write only a root manifest.jsonl, so the suite cannot see it. (b) bin/watcher.mjs:254-262: `const version = await runHerdr(['--version']); const gate = versionGate(version.ok ? version.stdout : '', TESTED_CEILING);` — a FAILED probe (herdr not on PATH, transient IPC hiccup) is passed as `''`, parsed as `untested herdr version (unparseable)`, published through the same shim that just failed, and `main()` returns: no stderr line, no retry, observer silently off for the whole session. test/watcher.test.mjs:211 pins versionGate's unparseable behaviour, which stays correct — the defect is conflating a probe FAILURE with an unparseable SUCCESS.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Plugin `plugins/adlc-herdr` (zero-dependency by design — nothing imports from packages/*; inline what you need the way lib/repo-root.mjs inlines `ticketStoreExists`): lib/adlc-state.mjs (`readdirBounded(dir, maxEntries)` at :18 fails soft to []; `readTailText(path, LEDGER_TAIL_BYTES)`; the three readers), lib/tokens.mjs (`versionGate(versionOutput, ceiling)` :88 — rail, unchanged), bin/watcher.mjs (`main()` :253-268, `runHerdr` returns `{ ok, stdout, ... }`, `HEARTBEAT_MS`, `refresh`, `subscribeSocket`), bin/board.mjs (consumes the readers), test/watcher.test.mjs, test/board.test.mjs, test/watcher-e2e.test.mjs (shows how the suite fakes a herdr binary — reuse that shim pattern; a fake CLI must drain stdin). A segmented repo is one whose `.adlc/manifest.d/` directory exists; segment files are named `<branch>-<ULID>.jsonl` and the ULID is the last 26 characters before `.jsonl`. Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/*.test.mjs` from the worktree root (find the root runner segment name in scripts/run-tests.mjs).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. ONE exported function in lib/adlc-state.mjs, `ledgerSources(repoRoot)`, returns the ordered list of ledger files to read: the root `.adlc/manifest.jsonl` when it exists, then every REGULAR file (lstat; symlinks and directories skipped) matching `/\.jsonl$/` in `.adlc/manifest.d/` enumerated with `readdirBounded(dir, MAX_LEDGER_SEGMENTS)` where `MAX_LEDGER_SEGMENTS = 256` is a named constant, sorted ascending by the 26-char ULID suffix (files without a parseable suffix sort first, by name). It never throws; a missing directory yields only the root (or []).
2. ONE exported pure function, `mergeLedgerRecords(recordLists)`, takes an array of record arrays (one per source, each already tail-parsed, torn lines skipped) and returns one array ordered by record `ts` (ISO string compare) ascending, ties broken by source order then line order; records with a non-string `ts` sort before all timestamped ones in their source order. It does not mutate its inputs.
3. The three readers use them: each source is tail-read with the existing `readTailText(path, LEDGER_TAIL_BYTES)` and parsed exactly as today; `readLedgerTail` returns the last `n` merged records; `readLedgerByTicket` keeps its last-occurrence-per-ticket semantics over the merged order; `readLatestPhase` returns the phase of the newest merged record for the ticket. Behaviour on a never-segmented repo is byte-identical to today.
4. Watcher probe: ONE exported pure function in lib/tokens.mjs, `probeOutcome(version, ceiling)` → `{ kind: 'probe-failed', detail }` when `version.ok !== true`, else `{ kind: 'unsupported', token }` when `versionGate(version.stdout, ceiling).supported` is false, else `{ kind: 'supported' }`. `main()` uses it: on `probe-failed` it prints ONE stderr line `[adlc watcher] herdr --version probe failed: <detail>; retrying in <HEARTBEAT_MS> ms`, publishes NO token, and schedules a re-probe after HEARTBEAT_MS (unref'd timer) that re-runs the same decision; on `unsupported` the existing degrade path (publish the token, return) is unchanged; on `supported` the existing start-up path is unchanged. `detail` is the probe's stderr or error message, trimmed, max 200 chars.
5. Documentation: `plugins/adlc-herdr/README.md` gains one sentence under the board/ledger description (near :60) that the gate-ledger panes read the frozen root ledger plus every `.adlc/manifest.d/` segment, and one sentence near the version requirement (:37) that a failed `herdr --version` probe is retried on the heartbeat and logged to stderr rather than disabling the watcher. There is no docs-site page for this plugin.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Segmented fixture (root manifest.jsonl with an old record + two `.adlc/manifest.d/<branch>-<ULID>.jsonl` segments with newer records + a symlink and a nested directory in manifest.d): `readLedgerTail(root, 8)` includes the segment records newest-last, `readLedgerByTicket` shows the segment record for a ticket whose only evidence is segment-side, `readLatestPhase` returns that record's phase uppercased; the symlink and directory are never read. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/ledger-forest.test.mjs`
- AC2 `ledgerSources` ordering: root first, then segments by ULID suffix; a fixture with 300 segment files returns at most 256 + root (readdirBounded fail-soft is NOT triggered into [] — assert the length). `mergeLedgerRecords` ordering table incl. missing `ts`; inputs not mutated. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/ledger-forest.test.mjs`
- AC3 A never-segmented fixture (root only) returns exactly what the readers return today — pin by running the three readers against the existing watcher/board fixture shape and comparing to expected literals. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/ledger-forest.test.mjs`
- AC4 `probeOutcome` table: `{ok:false, stderr:'ENOENT'}` → probe-failed with detail; `{ok:true, stdout:'herdr 9.9.9'}` → unsupported with the existing token text; `{ok:true, stdout:'herdr 0.7.4'}` → supported; `{ok:true, stdout:''}` → unsupported (versionGate's unparseable token — unchanged). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/watcher-probe.test.mjs`
- AC5 Through the real bin with a fake herdr whose `--version` fails on the first call and succeeds on the second: the first attempt prints the stderr retry line and issues NO `report-metadata` call; after the retry the watcher proceeds to its normal start (observable via the shim's recorded argv or the clear-token call). Use a short heartbeat via whatever seam watcher.mjs already exposes or an env override you add and document in the PR body. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/watcher-probe.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suite green and untouched, including test/watcher.test.mjs:211. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC7 Docs updated. verify: `grep -c "manifest.d" plugins/adlc-herdr/README.md` (>= 1) and `grep -c "retried" plugins/adlc-herdr/README.md` (>= 1)
- AC8 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: #831 (TESTED_CEILING equals min version), #834-#837 (README actions, tail panes, nudge window), changing `versionGate`, importing from packages/*, herdr-plugin.toml.
title: adlc-herdr: ledger readers see the manifest forest, and a failed version probe retries instead of disabling the watcher
